veranderings.voor: kan vergeet word of anders onthou word
veranderings.na: kan vergeet of anders onthou word
veranderings.rede: The two passive verbs share one auxiliary, so the repeated 'word' is wooden.
The dependent clause follows the past 'wou hê', so the modal should be past too.

veranderings.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
veranderings.rede: A bare passive infinitive as subject reads clipped; the 'om ... te' form is the natural Afrikaans subject and matches the lesson's own 'Om 'n kind te boelie, is misbruik'.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Armoede alleen is nie verwaarlosing nie.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This protected sentence does not appear in the lesson; the 'verwaarlosing' entry instead ends with ''n Gesin se armoede alleen is nie 'n rede om 'n kind uit die gesin weg te neem nie.' A person may want to confirm which wording is intended.
